jr-test-filter.what: test-filter-aware compilation: jr-rustc's harness holds only the tests the libtest filter selects (JUSTRUST_RUSTC_TEST_FILTER); the other 1311 are type-checked, not codegened
jr-test-filter.note: reference loop, filter fps_counter (3 of 1314 tests)

jr-cutoff.what: cross-crate early cutoff: jr-rustc records each crate's interface hash (-Zjr-iface-hash, metadata minus spans), jr-cargo skips dependents of a crate whose interface did not change, jr-rustc loads them against the new build
jr-cutoff.note: body edit in jcode-desktop-ui-core: 2 sibling dependents cut off

jr-cutoff-deep.what: same, body edit in jcode-core (Jcode repo, 15 dependents)

jr-cutoff-cost.what: same, on the UI crate's own body-check loop: nothing to cut off, measures what the interface hash costs (hashing, larger rmeta of every dependency with padded spans)
jr-cutoff-cost.note: cost side: on should equal off

jr-test-filter-body.what: same, body edit in non-test code
